stemMd: An exploded axonometric drawing separates the parts of an assembly along specified directions. What information is its main advantage over a single closed exterior view?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The exact colour under every light source

options.label: C
options.textMd: The relative arrangement of concealed components and how they fit together

options.label: D
options.textMd: A guaranteed true-scale image of every face

options.label: E
options.textMd: The legal ownership of each component

explanationMd: Moving parts apart in a controlled drawing reveals interfaces and relative placement that a closed view hides. Alignment guides preserve the assembly relationships. This does not make all faces true-size or supply non-geometric information.

distractorRationale.a: The diagram does not determine lighting-dependent appearance.
distractorRationale.e: Ownership is not a geometric property.
distractorRationale.b: Separation is used to reveal those relationships.
